filter_recent_runtime_hours_per_day.name: Filter recent runtime hours per day

user.title: Connect Beestat
user.description: Connect your Beestat account to import HVAC history, schedules, alerts, and thermostat details into Home Assistant. The integration calculates filter estimates locally from Beestat runtime. Local thermostat control stays with the integration providing it.

data_description.api_key: Enter the API key for your Beestat account. Home Assistant stores it in this integration entry.
data_description.api_base: Keep the default Beestat API endpoint unless you operate a trusted alternative. The API key is sent to this address.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Beestat Statistics
reconfigure.description: Update the connection used by this integration. A possible account change requires a separate confirmation.

data_description.api_key: Enter a replacement key, or leave this blank to keep the saved key.
data_description.api_base: Keep the default Beestat API endpoint unless you operate a trusted alternative. The API key is sent to this address.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Beestat Statistics
reauth_confirm.description: Beestat rejected the saved credentials. Enter a valid API key to reconnect.

data_description.api_key: Enter a valid API key for the Beestat account you want to use.
data_description.api_base: Keep the default Beestat API endpoint unless you operate a trusted alternative. The API key is sent to this address.

account_change_confirm.title: Confirm Beestat account change
account_change_confirm.description: These credentials may belong to a different Beestat account. Continuing clears source selections and per-source settings, including mappings and saved filter changes, then discovers the new account's sources. Import timing and Recorder history remain; a source with the same statistic slug can continue an existing history series. Continue only if you intend this account and history change.

error.account_identity_unavailable: Beestat returned no usable thermostat identity. Confirm that the account contains a thermostat, then try again.
error.invalid_auth: Beestat rejected this API key. Check the key and try again.
error.invalid_api_base: Enter an HTTPS URL with no username, password, query string, or fragment.
error.mapping_source_unavailable: A selected entity has no usable registry identity. Select an entity currently registered in Home Assistant.
error.cannot_connect: The Beestat request failed. Check the API URL and Home Assistant's connection, then try again.
error.unknown: Setup could not finish. Check the Home Assistant logs for Beestat Statistics, then try again.

abort.account_identity_unavailable: The connection could not be saved because Beestat returned no usable thermostat identity.
abort.configuration_changed: The saved configuration changed while this form was open. Reopen the form to review the current settings.
abort.yaml_connection_unavailable: The Beestat connection in YAML could not be validated. Check its API key and URL.
abort.yaml_connection_change_requires_reconfig: The YAML connection could not be confirmed as the saved account. Open Reconfigure for Beestat Statistics to validate and confirm it, then make YAML match the saved connection.

beestat_auth_failed.message: Beestat rejected the saved API key. Reauthenticate Beestat Statistics to reconnect.

beestat_request_failed.message: The Beestat request did not complete. Check the integration status and Home Assistant logs.

invalid_api_base.message: The saved API URL is invalid. Reconfigure it with an HTTPS URL containing no username, password, query string, or fragment.

filter_change_boundary_date_mismatch.message: Save a Home Assistant filter-date override first, then use a time on that same date in Home Assistant's time zone.

filter_change_boundary_local_time_invali.message: This local time is ambiguous or does not exist because of a clock change. Enter the timestamp with an explicit UTC offset.

filter_change_boundary_out_of_range.message: Enter a replacement time within the past 31 days and no later than now.

no_loaded_entry.message: Beestat Statistics must be loaded before this action can run.

invalid_rebuild_date_range.message: The start date must be on or before the end date.

unknown_thermostat_id.message: Thermostat {thermostat_id} is not included in the current Beestat configuration.

statistics_import_failed.message: The statistics import did not finish. Check the integration status and Home Assistant logs before trying again.

hourly_statistics_failed.message: The hourly statistics action did not finish. Read the current hourly status and coverage, then review the selection and revision before retrying.

raw_points_admin_required.message: An active Home Assistant administrator must call this action.

raw_points_invalid.message: Choose one configured thermostat or room sensor and an explicit time window of at most 31 elapsed days. Use timestamps with UTC offsets and no fractional seconds.

raw_points_failed.message: The raw point read did not finish. Check the integration status and retry a smaller window if necessary.

filter_change_boundary_conflict.message: The saved filter cycle differs from the expected values. Read the current saved filter state and review it before submitting again.

filter_change_not_after_prior.message: A replacement must be later than the previous saved timestamp and cannot precede its saved date. To correct an existing record, edit Filter changed date or use Repair filter change boundary.

request_id_reused.message: This request ID already belongs to a different replacement. Use a new ID for a new replacement.

hourly_history_admin_required.message: An active Home Assistant administrator must call this hourly history action.

invalid_override_entity_domains.title: Beestat override entities use the wrong domain
invalid_override_entity_domains.description: These mappings select an entity of the wrong type: {entities}. Open the integration's mapping options and choose a climate, temperature, occupancy, or motion entity as appropriate; filter helpers must use input_datetime.

mapping_device_conflicts.title: Beestat mappings select conflicting source devices
mapping_device_conflicts.description: {conflict_count} conflict(s) prevent a unique mapping. Choose entities for the same physical device and avoid reusing that device for other sources of the same type. Device links and temperature projections for affected mappings remain disabled until corrected. A cross-integration thermostat probe requires matching hardware identity.

missing_override_entities.title: Beestat override entities are missing
missing_override_entities.description: These saved entity mappings cannot be resolved: {entities}. Restore the entities or select their replacements in the integration's mapping options.

insecure_api_base.title: Beestat API URL is invalid or insecure
insecure_api_base.description: The saved API URL was rejected before sending credentials. Open Reconfigure and use the default Beestat endpoint or another trusted HTTPS endpoint without embedded credentials, a query string, or a fragment.

yaml_connection_change_requires_reconfig.title: Beestat YAML connection change needs confirmation
yaml_connection_change_requires_reconfig.description: The YAML connection could not be confirmed as the saved Beestat account. Open Reconfigure to review its API key and URL and confirm any account switch. Keep YAML aligned with the connection you choose.

get_raw_points.name: Get raw Beestat points
get_raw_points.description: Read bounded point history for one configured resource using cached identity metadata. Requires an active administrator. Does not sync or refresh Beestat, import statistics, or change saved state. The response contains private raw history.

config_entry_id.name: Configuration entry
config_entry_id.description: Loaded Beestat Statistics entry containing the resource.

resource_id.name: Resource ID
resource_id.description: Positive integer ID of a configured thermostat or room sensor.

start.name: Start timestamp
start.description: Inclusive timestamp with an explicit UTC offset and no fractional seconds.

end.name: End timestamp
end.description: Inclusive timestamp after start, at most 31 elapsed days later, with an explicit UTC offset and no fractional seconds.

select_hourly_statistics.name: Select hourly Beestat statistics
select_hourly_statistics.description: Preview explicitly selected hourly statistics or a recovery segment. To apply, repeat the same selection with its returned preview digest and expected revision. Reads Beestat history and can reconcile pending effects. Applying freezes legacy writes for selected quantities and updates retained selection and Recorder statistics. Other enabled quantities continue daily imports.

config_entry_id.name: Configuration entry
config_entry_id.description: Loaded Beestat Statistics entry to select.

epoch_start.name: First hour
epoch_start.description: Whole UTC hour with an explicit offset, within the past 366 days.

statistic_ids.name: Statistic IDs
statistic_ids.description: Explicit hourly base statistic IDs to select; no automatic selection.

expected_revision.name: Expected revision
expected_revision.description: Current hourly statistics revision from Get Beestat configuration.

preview_digest.name: Preview digest
preview_digest.description: Omit for a preview. Supply the returned digest to apply that exact selection.

get_hourly_coverage.name: Get hourly Beestat coverage
get_hourly_coverage.description: Read cached v2 coverage or, with contract version 3, qualified logical history and bounded Recorder verification. Does not contact Beestat, import statistics, reconcile pending work, or change retained state.

config_entry_id.name: Configuration entry
config_entry_id.description: Loaded Beestat Statistics entry to inspect.

start.name: Start hour
start.description: Inclusive whole UTC hour with an explicit offset.

end.name: End hour
end.description: Exclusive whole UTC hour, at most 366 elapsed days after start.

statistic_ids.name: Statistic IDs
statistic_ids.description: V2 only. Omit to inspect all selected hourly series. For contract version 3 use quantity IDs.

contract_version.name: Contract version
contract_version.description: Set to 3 for qualified logical history. Omit to retain the v2 coverage response.

quantity_ids.name: Quantity IDs
quantity_ids.description: Required for contract version 3. Select 1–40 distinct physical quantity IDs from Get Beestat configuration.

period.name: Bucket period
period.description: Contract version 3 only. Hourly UTC buckets or local calendar days; defaults to hour.

daily_policy.name: Daily history policy
daily_policy.description: Contract version 3 only. Prefer complete point days, then qualified closed legacy days, then partial point subtotals. Never adds the sources.

page_size.name: Page size
page_size.description: Contract version 3 only. Maximum returned buckets across all quantities, from 1 to 4096; defaults to 4096.

offset.name: Page offset
offset.description: Contract version 3 only. Zero-based bucket offset; defaults to 0. For later pages use the returned next_offset.

view_token.name: View token
view_token.description: Contract version 3 only. Repeat the returned 64-character SHA-256 view token on later pages to reject changed history.

evaluated_at.name: Evaluation timestamp
evaluated_at.description: Contract version 3 only. Repeat the returned evaluation timestamp, including its UTC offset, on later pages.

get_configuration.name: Get Beestat configuration
get_configuration.description: Read saved settings, effective mappings, filter state, hourly status, and source details without contacting Beestat or changing state. Credentials are omitted; private identifiers and household details are included.

config_entry_id.name: Configuration entry
config_entry_id.description: Loaded Beestat Statistics entry to inspect.

import_statistics.name: Import Beestat statistics
import_statistics.description: Refresh Beestat runtime and metadata, update integration entities, and import history using hourly statistics for selected quantities and daily statistics for enabled quantities that have not been selected.

point_lookback_days.name: Point lookback days
point_lookback_days.description: Days of five-minute thermostat and room-sensor history to read for this import. Omit to use the configured lookback.

skip_sync.name: Skip Beestat sync
skip_sync.description: Skip requesting a Beestat refresh from ecobee. The import still reads data from Beestat over the network.

rebuild_statistics.name: Rebuild Beestat statistics
rebuild_statistics.description: Reimport historical Beestat statistics. Cumulative totals are rebuilt from the start date through the latest available source interval; measurement series use the selected date range.

thermostat_id.name: Thermostat ID
thermostat_id.description: Beestat thermostat to rebuild, including its room sensors. Omit to rebuild all included sources.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: First local date to update in Recorder. Daily mode uses summary history; hourly mode requires raw observations and verified continuity, within 366 elapsed days. Omit to use the configured history lookback for hourly data.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last local date to update for measurements. Cumulative totals are updated through the latest available source interval. Omit to read point history through now.

skip_sync.name: Skip Beestat sync
skip_sync.description: Skip requesting a Beestat refresh from ecobee. The rebuild still reads data from Beestat over the network.

repair_filter_change_boundary.name: Repair filter change boundary
repair_filter_change_boundary.description: Correct the time of a filter change already saved in Home Assistant on the same date. Refreshes Beestat to recalculate runtime; reconciliation may remain pending. This correction does not dismiss filter alerts.

config_entry_id.name: Configuration entry
config_entry_id.description: Loaded Beestat Statistics entry containing the thermostat.

thermostat_id.name: Thermostat ID
thermostat_id.description: Beestat thermostat with a saved Home Assistant filter-date override to correct.

changed_at.name: Changed at
changed_at.description: Verified replacement time on the saved date, within the past 31 days. Dates use Home Assistant's time zone; include a UTC offset to avoid clock-change ambiguity.

record_filter_change.name: Record filter change
record_filter_change.description: Record a completed physical filter replacement using its actual time and the captured previous saved state. Keep that previous state unchanged on retries. Attempts to dismiss matching filter alerts and refresh runtime. Check the returned status; runtime reconciliation may remain pending.

config_entry_id.name: Configuration entry
config_entry_id.description: Loaded Beestat Statistics entry containing the thermostat.

thermostat_id.name: Thermostat ID
thermostat_id.description: Beestat thermostat whose filter was replaced.

changed_at.name: Changed at
changed_at.description: Actual replacement time within the past 31 days, no later than now, after any saved timestamp and not before the saved date. Include a UTC offset to distinguish repeated local times.

expected_changed_at.name: Expected previous timestamp
expected_changed_at.description: Previous filter_changed_at from saved_overrides.thermostats in Get Beestat configuration. Use null when absent.

expected_changed_date.name: Expected previous date
expected_changed_date.description: Previous filter_changed_date from saved_overrides.thermostats in Get Beestat configuration. Use null when absent.

expected_request_id.name: Expected previous request ID
expected_request_id.description: Previous filter_change_event.request_id from saved_overrides.thermostats in Get Beestat configuration. Use null when absent.

request_id.name: Request ID
request_id.description: Unique ID for this replacement, 1–128 characters. Reuse the same ID and replacement time when retrying the same request.

stage_hourly_source.name: Stage hourly Beestat source
stage_hourly_source.description: Retain one verified original JSON or JSONL source chunk and its sealed manifest. Requires an active administrator. Does not select quantities, change writer reservations, or write Recorder statistics.

config_entry_id.name: Configuration entry
config_entry_id.description: Loaded Beestat Statistics entry whose physical source identity matches the manifest.

file_id.name: Source file
file_id.description: Original UTF-8 JSON or JSONL chunk, at most 8 MiB and 10,000 rows. Uses the native upload handle; paths and URLs are not accepted.

sha256.name: Original file digest
sha256.description: Exact 64-character lowercase SHA-256 digest of the original uploaded bytes.

manifest.name: Source manifest
manifest.description: Contract 3 source manifest containing entry/account/resource identity, acquisition and chunk order, format, explicit-offset timestamps, source kind, and beestat_points_v1 unit contract.

plan_hourly_history.name: Plan hourly Beestat history
plan_hourly_history.description: Read sealed source evidence, current ownership, and bounded Recorder rows to prepare an exact adoption or repair plan. Requires an active administrator. Does not fetch source data, reconcile pending work, or change state.

config_entry_id.name: Configuration entry
config_entry_id.description: Loaded Beestat Statistics entry to plan.

source_ids.name: Sealed source IDs
source_ids.description: From 1 to 2048 distinct source manifest SHA-256 IDs returned by Stage hourly Beestat source.

quantity_ids.name: Quantity IDs
quantity_ids.description: From 1 to 40 distinct physical quantity IDs from Get Beestat configuration.

start.name: Start hour
start.description: Inclusive whole UTC hour with an explicit offset.

end.name: End hour
end.description: Exclusive whole UTC hour with an explicit offset, at most 366 elapsed days after start.

archive_policy.name: Archive admission policy
archive_policy.description: Reject archives, or explicitly qualify archive-only points before the first provider point. Conflicting observations remain blocked.

daily_policy.name: Daily history policy
daily_policy.description: Prefer complete point days, then qualified closed legacy days, then partial point subtotals. Never adds the sources.

operation_id.name: Operation ID
operation_id.description: Unique ID for this exact operation, 1–256 characters. Reuse only for the same intended plan.

expected_revision.name: Expected revision
expected_revision.description: Current nonnegative integer history_v3 revision from Get Beestat configuration.

consumer_contract.name: Consumer contract
consumer_contract.description: Contract version 3 and 1–16 consumers, each declaring consumer_id, version, history_contract 3, and daily_policy complete_points_else_legacy_day. This declaration does not validate the consumers.

recovery_reference.name: Recovery reference
recovery_reference.description: Reference to the consistent recovery set, 1–256 characters. This declaration does not create or verify a backup.

evaluated_at.name: Evaluation timestamp
evaluated_at.description: Omit for the first plan. Repeat the returned timestamp with its UTC offset when requesting more detail pages of that plan.

detail_offset.name: Detail offset
detail_offset.description: Zero-based batch detail offset. Does not change the semantic plan digest.

detail_limit.name: Detail limit
detail_limit.description: Maximum batch details to return, from 1 to 100.

apply_hourly_history.name: Apply hourly Beestat history
apply_hourly_history.description: Accept the exact reviewed plan and reserve its selected quantities for v3. Requires an active administrator. The entry worker writes and verifies Recorder batches; inspect history status for completion or a blocked operation.

config_entry_id.name: Configuration entry
config_entry_id.description: Loaded Beestat Statistics entry matching the nested plan.

plan_digest.name: Plan digest
plan_digest.description: Exact 64-character lowercase SHA-256 plan_digest returned by Plan hourly Beestat history.

plan.name: Exact plan request
plan.description: Complete unchanged request object returned by Plan hourly Beestat history, including its config_entry_id, evaluated_at, consumer contract, recovery reference, and expected revision.

init.title: Beestat Statistics options
init.description: Choose import timing, included Beestat sources, or the local entities associated with each thermostat and room sensor.

timing.title: Import timing
timing.description: Set how often statistics are imported and how much recent point history each import reads. More frequent imports cannot make Beestat publish data sooner.

data_description.point_lookback_days: Days of thermostat and room-sensor point history to read per import. Default: 45. Daily runtime summaries use a separate import window.
data_description.scan_interval_seconds: Seconds between scheduled imports. Default: 21600 (6 hours); minimum: 300.

source_scope.title: Choose Beestat sources
source_scope.description: Choose which discovered thermostats and room sensors to load and import. Newly discovered active sources are included by default; excluding a listed source stops its future updates and imports while retaining Recorder history.

data_description.included_thermostat_ids: Select the thermostats to include. Clearing the selection excludes all listed thermostats.
data_description.included_sensor_ids: Select the room sensors to include. Clearing the selection excludes all listed room sensors.

source_scope_confirm.title: Confirm source exclusions
source_scope_confirm.description: Stop loading Beestat entities and importing data for {thermostat_count} thermostat(s) and {sensor_count} room sensor(s)? Existing Recorder statistics remain. You can include these sources again in the source selection.

confirm_automatic_mappings.title: Confirm automatic HomeKit mappings

thermostat_mapping.title: Map a Beestat thermostat
thermostat_mapping.description: Choose the Beestat thermostat whose local entity mappings or filter settings you want to edit.

data_description.id: Thermostat discovered in your Beestat account.

thermostat_mapping_detail.title: Thermostat HomeKit mapping
thermostat_mapping_detail.description: Configure {item}. Select entities for the same physical thermostat; clear a selection to restore automatic matching. Filter estimates are calculated locally from Beestat history. Choose limits suitable for your filter and equipment. See the integration guide for mapping and filter tracking.

data_description.climate_entity_id: Local climate entity for this thermostat. The mapping associates its Home Assistant device with Beestat data.
data_description.temperature_entity_id: Local temperature sensor for this thermostat.
data_description.occupancy_entity_id: Local occupancy sensor for this thermostat.
data_description.motion_entity_id: Local motion sensor for this thermostat.
data_description.filter_changed_entity_id: Optional input_datetime helper used as a fallback filter date. Clear to allow automatic helper discovery. New setups can use the integration's Filter changed date entity.
data_description.filter_lifetime_runtime_hours: Recorded fan-runtime limit for the filter estimate. The 250-hour software default is not an equipment recommendation. Incomplete history makes runtime projections provisional.
data_description.filter_max_age_days: Calendar-age limit from the effective filter date, including when runtime history is incomplete. The 90-day software default is not an equipment recommendation.
data_description.filter_notice_days: Turn on Filter due soon this many days before the estimated due date. Default: 7; 0 means the due date. Set up an automation to send a notification.

sensor_mapping.title: Map a Beestat room sensor
sensor_mapping.description: Choose the Beestat room sensor whose local entity mappings or imported measurements you want to edit.

data_description.id: Room sensor discovered in your Beestat account.

sensor_mapping_detail.title: Room sensor HomeKit mapping
sensor_mapping_detail.description: Configure {item}. Select local entities for the same physical sensor; clear a selection to restore automatic matching. Choose which measurements to import.

data_description.thermostat_id: Override the owning Beestat thermostat. This takes precedence over the ownership reported by Beestat.
data_description.temperature_entity_id: Local temperature sensor for this room sensor.
data_description.occupancy_entity_id: Local occupancy sensor for this room sensor.
data_description.motion_entity_id: Local motion sensor for this room sensor.
data_description.include_temperature: Import temperature history when Beestat supplies it for this sensor.
data_description.include_air_quality: Import the air-quality history supplied by Beestat for this sensor.
data_description.include_co2: Import the CO2 history supplied by Beestat for this sensor.
data_description.include_voc: Import the TVOC history supplied by Beestat for this sensor.

error.mapping_device_conflict: Choose entities for one physical device and avoid reusing it for sources of the same type. A thermostat probe from another integration needs matching hardware identity.
error.mapping_source_unavailable: A selected entity has no usable registry identity. Select an entity currently registered in Home Assistant.
error.no_discovered_items: No Beestat sources are available for this selection. Check the integration status and refresh runtime data.

abort.no_automatic_mappings: No unconfirmed automatic mappings are currently available. Existing explicit mappings were left unchanged.
